name: Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN, until 1994)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the ASEAN emblem: a yellow disc with a light-blue ring bearing six brown paddy stalks bound together, above the word 'asean' in blue.
history: The first ASEAN flag, a white flag with the original emblem of six bound rice stalks. It was replaced at the Ministerial Meeting in Bangkok on 23 July 1994 by a light-blue flag, which in turn gave way to the current ten-stalk design in 1997.

features.symbolism: the five founding members and Brunei
